stepTitle: Gate Oracle Foundation Without Deferred Status
description: Gates the oracle-lane foundation (02-001 through 02-034) by tracking deferred-status fixtures explicitly. The gate's literal title is `without deferred status`: this is the long-term close contract. Until an external reference-run host produces live evidence, the gate manifest pins the open dependency on the 02-034 tracker so downstream steps know which fixtures remain pending. The focused test enforces that every pending fixture is accounted for in the 02-034 tracker (no orphan deferred status); long-term close requires every fixture to read captured.
gateRule: every fixture under test/vanilla_parity/oracles/ that declares captureStatus must either (a) report 'captured', or (b) appear in the 02-034 tracker so its pending status is not orphaned; long-term close requires every captureStatus to be 'captured'.
deferredStatusContract: Pending status is tolerated only while the 02-034 tracker records it. Any pending fixture not listed in the tracker is a hard failure. When all tracker entries resolve to 'captured', the long-term gate close is satisfied automatically.
longTermCloseCondition: 0 pending fixtures across test/vanilla_parity/oracles/ AND 02-034 trackerStatus = closed
